title: Composition isomorphisms of derived inverse images and their coherence
statement:
Let $u:Y\to X$, $v:Z\to Y$, $w:W\to Z$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with the sheaf-level inverse images on abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], their composition isomorphisms $c_{u,v}:v^{-1}u^{-1}\xrightarrow{\sim}(u\circ v)^{-1}$ and identity isomorphisms $e_X:\mathrm{id}_X^{-1}\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathrm{id}$ [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition], and the inverse images $u^{-1}:\Dplus(X_{\Et})\to\Dplus(Y_{\Et})$ on the bounded below derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image], with $\varphi_{u,K^\bullet}:u^{-1}(QK^\bullet)\xrightarrow{\sim}Q(u^{-1}K^\bullet)$ for bounded below complexes $K^\bullet$.

1. (Sheaf level.) $c$ and $e$ are associative and unital: $c_{u,v\circ w}\circ(c_{v,w}u^{-1})=c_{u\circ v,w}\circ(w^{-1}c_{u,v}):w^{-1}v^{-1}u^{-1}\to(u\circ v\circ w)^{-1}$, $c_{\mathrm{id}_X,u}=u^{-1}e_X:u^{-1}\mathrm{id}_X^{-1}\to u^{-1}$ and $c_{u,\mathrm{id}_Y}=e_Yu^{-1}:\mathrm{id}_Y^{-1}u^{-1}\to u^{-1}$.
2. (Derived level.) There are unique natural isomorphisms $c^D_{u,v}:v^{-1}u^{-1}\xrightarrow{\sim}(u\circ v)^{-1}$ of functors $\Dplus(X_{\Et})\to\Dplus(Z_{\Et})$ and $e^D_X:\mathrm{id}_X^{-1}\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathrm{id}$ on $\Dplus(X_{\Et})$ whose components at $QK^\bullet$ are, after the identifications $\varphi$, the classes $Q((c_{u,v,K^r})_r)$ and $Q((e_{X,K^r})_r)$ of the termwise isomorphisms, i.e. $\varphi_{u\circ v,K^\bullet}\circ c^D_{u,v,QK^\bullet}=Q((c_{u,v,K^r})_r)\circ\varphi_{v,u^{-1}K^\bullet}\circ v^{-1}(\varphi_{u,K^\bullet})$ and $e^D_{X,QK^\bullet}=Q((e_{X,K^r})_r)\circ\varphi_{\mathrm{id}_X,K^\bullet}$.
3. (Derived coherence.) $c^D,e^D$ satisfy the identities of (1) with $c,e$ replaced by $c^D,e^D$.

proof.text: Specialize the existing source-library sheaf coherence lemmas upperStarComp_assoc, upperStarComp_id_right and upperStarComp_id_left to abelian groups. Apply Iso.inv to associativity and evaluate components to remove the identity associator. Evaluate the inverse unit comparisons componentwise to remove the identity unitors. These are exactly the first three conjuncts, with c defined as the inverse of upperStarComp.

For composition, specialize upperStarCompDerivedPlus_hom_app_factorsh_assoc. Precompose the desired inverse formula with the hom of the derived composition isomorphism, use hom-inv cancellation, and apply the source formula. Functoriality of Qh and mapHomotopyCategoryPlus turns the remaining sheaf hom-inv composite into an identity. If t satisfies this formula, cancel the factorization isomorphism to show that its components agree with the canonical inverse on all Qh objects; Localization.natTrans_ext then gives equality of natural transformations, and Iso.ext gives equality of isomorphisms. Conversely substitute the canonical isomorphism.

For identity, upperStarIdDerivedPlus_hom_app is exactly the prescribed formula. Localization.natTrans_ext compares any isomorphism satisfying that formula with upperStarIdDerivedPlus on all Qh objects; Iso.ext concludes uniqueness. Substitution proves the converse.

Specialize the already proved source-library theorem upperStarCompDerivedPlus_assoc from WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.Etale.Derived.UpperStarCompAssoc. Apply IsIso.inv_eq_inv to its two invertible natural transformations, then expand the inverses of composites and whiskered transformations. The resulting reversed equality is exactly derived associativity in the convention cD = upperStarCompDerivedPlus.symm. For the two unit laws, cancel the epi upperStarCompDerivedPlus.hom and use the existing source-library upperStarCompDerivedPlus_id_right and upperStarCompDerivedPlus_id_left laws componentwise; the unitor components are identities.

proof_origin.place: upperStarCompDerivedPlus_assoc; UpperLowerStarCoherence.lean: upperStarCompDerivedPlus_hom_app_factorsh and upperStarIdDerivedPlus_hom_app; BaseChange/DerivedPasting/Identity.lean: upperStarCompDerivedPlus_id_left and _id_right; Etale/UpperLowerStar/Coherence.lean: sheaf coherence. J1 specializes these proved results and supplies inverse-form cancellation and localization uniqueness. Second reader J1 keeps the whole proof in one module, proving the conjunction locally for abstract Grothendieck abelian coefficient instances and specializing to AddCommGrpCat; no extracted helper or new public declaration.

split_report.summary: Statement kept (checked: the typings of the associativity and unit laws, and the formulas of (2), are right). Proof in six steps: (1)-(2) the sheaf-level associativity and unit laws from the uniqueness clause of lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition, comparing both sides through the unit equations; this needs the associativity and unit laws of the direct-image isomorphisms d (fibre-product identifications), split off as the new node lem-weil-pbc-direct-image-composition-coherence (unsplit; source Lean Etale.lowerStarComp_assoc/_id_left/_id_right, sorry-free). (3) c^D, e^D on D as lifts of the termwise c, e through the localization (lem-weil-pbc-localization-universal-property (2)); (4) restriction to D^+, with uniqueness on D^+ from lem-weil-pbc-dplus-injective-representative; (5)-(6) the derived laws by computing both sides at QK through the naturality of phi and the sheaf-level laws, then the uniqueness clause (3) of the localization, as in lem-weil-pbc-derived-square-iso-commshift Steps 4-5. Stacks (03CB, 0D6D) treats the composites as equalities, so the coherence is written by an agent. The Lean data upperStarCompDerivedPlus / upperStarIdDerivedPlus and the laws upperStarComp_assoc(') / _id_left / _id_right / upperStarCompDerivedPlus_id_left / _id_right are sorry-free; there is no derived associativity for the etale c^D in the source Lean (only the generic mapDerivedCategoryPlusCompIso_assoc). Searches added: leansearch, leanfinder, grep (pinned Mathlib lacks mapDerivedCategoryCompIso/IdIso).
